cd /app/tmp/fz && cat > cmp12.py <<'EOF'
import json,sys
sys.path.insert(0,'/app/tmp/fz')
from rp2 import Sim
from rp import sim
line=sys.stdin.read().strip()
req=json.loads(line)
P=len(req["inputs"]); R=len(req["inputs"][0]); D=len(req["inputs"][0][0])
inp=req["inputs"]; sn=req["slots"]; w=req["window"]; evs=req["events"]
s=Sim(P,R,D,inp,sn,w)
for i,ev in enumerate(evs):
    s.tick(ev)
ref=sim(P,R,D,inp,sn,w,evs)
mine=s.snapshot()
mine["events"]=None
ref2={k:ref[k] for k in ("hosts","floor","slots","packets")}
print("rp2==rp.sim:", mine==ref2)
for k in ref2:
    if ref2[k]!=mine[k]:
        print("field",k,"rp2",mine[k])
        print("field",k,"ref",ref2[k])
EOF
